messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the motion reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man begins standing still, then raises both arms overhead and twists his torso in a dance-like motion before returning to a stationary pose.","camera":"The camera maintains a static, medium-shot framing from the waist up at eye level.","clothing":"He wears a cream-colored knit sweater with a dark geometric pattern and purple ribbed trim, along with dark pants.","hair_color":"His hair is black.","hairstyle":"He has short, cropped dark hair with a clean fade on the sides.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short facial hair stands centered in the frame.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic environment featuring a large glass dome structure with glowing pink and green circular light rings against a twilight sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person now performs a dance-like motion: standing still, raising both arms overhead, twisting the torso, and returning to a stationary pose. The original person, sweater, futuristic dome scene, and static medium-shot framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to match the motion reference, while preserving identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression was fully preserved during the motion, since some frames show motion blur and head movement.
unexpected_changes: The executed motion is only an approximate match to the reference; the reference includes more distinct arm swings and body turns, while the output shows a simpler overhead arm raise and torso twist.
